name: VC Trader AI Retract Report
description: Withdraws a published report from the workspace library, with a required reason. Calls the propfirm_manager BFF at POST /api/v1/workspaces/{ws}/reports/{report_id}/retract as the workspace owner (PFM_AGENT_TOKEN, ADR 0078). DIRECT_CONTROL per core/openclaw/allowlist.py. It does NOT remove the report from any inbox message that already delivered it.
